summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on an OOH reporting issue where several new screens/locations were returning 0 audience data. Initial troubleshooting efforts by [me] did not resolve the problem, and the issue persisted.

It was determined that demography data is unavailable for these specific locations because citydata has not yet provided it. Normally, this data would be copied from a nearby location with available demographics, but the job to automate this process has not been created.
decisions: A ticket needs to be created regarding the missing demography data for the listed locations.
action_items: [p1] to check with Sarai and Lucas regarding who is responsible for mirroring the required data (Lucas or IT).
